arabic_title: دُعَاؤُهُ فِي الِاشْتِيَاقِ الى طَلَبِ المَغفِرَةِ مِن الله

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ
phrases.english: 1.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

phrases.arabic: وَصَيِّرْنَـا إلَى مَحْبُوبِكَ مِنَ التَّوْبَةِ
phrases.english: 2.make us go to the repentance that You lovest

phrases.arabic: وَأَزِلْنَا عَنْ مَكْرُوهِكَ مِنَ الإصْرَارِ.
phrases.english: 3.and make us leave the persistence that You hatest!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَمَتَى وَقَفْنَا بَيْنَ نَقْصَيْنِ فِي دِين
phrases.english: 4.O God, when we halt before two decreases, in religion

phrases.arabic: أَوْ دُنْيَا فَأَوْقِعِ النَّقْصَ بِأَسْرَعِهِمَا فَنَاءً ،
phrases.english: 5.or in this world, let the decrease fall upon that which passes quickly

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلِ التّوْبَةَ فِي أَطْوَلِهِمَا بَقَاءً.
phrases.english: 6.and relent in that which lasts the longer!

phrases.arabic: وَإذَا هَمَمْنَا بِهَمَّيْنِ يُرْضِيكَ أَحَدُهُمَا  عَنَّا
phrases.english: 7.When we set out after two concerns, one of which makes You pleased with us

phrases.arabic: وَيُسْخِطُكَ الآخَرُ عَلَيْنَا ،
phrases.english: 8.and the other of which displeases You,

phrases.arabic: فَمِلْ بِنَا إلَى مَا يُرْضِيْكَ عَنَّا ،
phrases.english: 9.incline us toward that which makes You pleased

phrases.arabic: وَأَوْهِنْ قُوَّتَنَا عَمَّا يُسْخِطُكَ عَلَيْنَا ،
phrases.english: 10.and weaken our strength in that which displeases You!

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ تُخَلِّ فِي  ذلِكَ بَيْنَ نُفُوسِنَا وَاخْتِيَارِهَا
phrases.english: 11.Leave not our souls alone to choose in that,

phrases.arabic: فَإنَّهَا مُخْتَارَةٌ لِلْبَاطِلِ إلاَّ مَا وَفَّقْتَ أَمَّارَةٌ بالسُّوءِ إلاّ مَا رَحِمْتَ
phrases.english: 12.for they choose falsehood except inasmuch as You givest success, and they command to evil except inasmuch as You hast mercy!

phrases.arabic: اللَّهمَّ وَإنَّكَ مِنَ الضَّعْفِ خَلَقْتَنَا،
phrases.english: 13.O God, You created us from frailty,

phrases.arabic: وَعَلَى الْوَهْنِ بَنَيْتَنَا ، وَمِنْ ماُءٌُِِ مَهِين ابْتَدَأتَنَا ،
phrases.english: 14.built us up from feebleness, and began us from a mean water;

phrases.arabic: فَلاَ حَوْلَ لَنَا  إلاّ بِقُوَّتِكَ وَلا قُوَّةَ لَنَا إلاّ بِعَونِِكَ ،
phrases.english: 15.we have no force except through Your strength and no strength except through Your help.

phrases.arabic: فَأيِّدْنَا بِتَوْفِيقِكَ وَسَدِّدْنَا بِتَسْدِيدِكَ
phrases.english: 16.So confirm us by giving us success, point us the right way by Your pointing,

phrases.arabic: وَأعْمِ أَبْصَارَ قُلُوبِنَا عَمَّا خَالَفَ مَحَبَّتَكَ
phrases.english: 17.blind the eyes of our hearts toward everything opposed to Your love,

phrases.arabic: وَلا تَجْعَلْ لِشَيْء مِنْ جَوَارِحِنَا نُفُوذاً فِي مَعْصِيَتِكَ.
phrases.english: 18.and set not in any of our limbs passage to disobeying You!

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَد وَآلِهِ
phrases.english: 19.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ هَمَسَاتِ قُلُوبِنَا وَحَرَكَاتِ أَعْضَائِنَا ،
phrases.english: 20.and assign the whisperings of our hearts, the movements of our members,

phrases.arabic: وَلَمَحَاتِ أَعْيُنِنَا ، وَلَهَجَاتِ ألسِنَتِنَا فِيْ مُوجِبَاتِ ثَوَابِكَ،
phrases.english: 21.the glances of our eyes, and the idioms of our tongues, to that which makes incumbent Your reward,

phrases.arabic: حَتَّى لاَ تَفُوتَنَا حَسَنَةٌ نَسْتَحِقُّ بِهَا جَزَآءَكَ ،
phrases.english: 22.lest a good deed slip by us, through which we might deserve Your repayment,

phrases.arabic: وَلا تَبْقَى لَنَا سَيِّئـةٌ نَسْتَوْجِبُ بِهَا عِقَابَكَ.
phrases.english: 23.or an evil deed remain with us, by which we might merit Your punishment!
